node.title: Re^2: Writing to an output file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
See [doc://select].

A very good point regarding the "all the printing" part of the question! [ameezys]: Note that the effect of [doc://select] is global, so it has the potential of affecting code in modules that you call after the select, and if you want to resume [doc://print]ing to STDOUT after writing the file, you'll have to store the return value of the first select to use for restoring the output handle later. Note you can always [doc://print] to a specific filehandle, e.g. print {$filehandle} $output; or print STDOUT $output;.
